login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: A learning bank and broker. All money is practice money.
login.name: Your name
login.hint: Developer mode: no password. A new name opens a new account.

instrument.haltedHint: A report comes out while the market is closed; trading resumes at the next open.

ticket.marketHint: Fills now at the best book prices; any unfilled rest is cancelled.
ticket.errPrice: Enter a price above zero with at most two decimals
ticket.errQty: Enter a whole quantity above zero

settings.title: Settings
settings.footer: Vetrilo is a learning app. All money is practice money.

errors.INVALID_NAME: Name: letters, digits, space, _ or -, up to 32
errors.LEVERAGE_NOT_ALLOWED: Leverage is not allowed for this instrument

stops.title: Stops and take-profits
stops.hintSL: Fires when the last trade price reaches the stop price (sell: at or below, buy: at or above).
stops.hintTP: Trailing take-profit: arms at the activation price, follows the best price and fires on a pull-back larger than the offset.
stops.hintTPSL: Take-profit and stop on one order: whichever comes first. Once the take-profit is armed, the stop is no longer checked.
stops.lastTradeNote: The condition watches the last trade price, not book quotes. A fired order may still not fill.
stops.errFields: Fill in prices and quantity: numbers above zero
stops.firedNotFilled: Fired ≠ filled: the order went to the book but is not fully filled.

size.title: Position size
size.formula: Quantity = capital × risk % ÷ |entry − stop|. That is what you lose if the stop fires.
size.perUnit: Loss per unit to the stop
size.fill: Enter capital, risk, entry and stop
size.formulaAtr: Stop distance = k × ATR; quantity = risk budget ÷ distance. ATR is the average daily swing of the price.
size.atrHint: ATR measures how much the price swings, not where it goes.
size.atrNotReady: Not enough data for ATR: {{have}} of {{need}} daily candles
size.oneR: The risk budget is 1 R; results are measured in R.
size.fillAtr: Enter capital, risk, entry and k; ATR must be ready

deposits.title: Deposits
deposits.compound: Compound interest: interest is added every bank day and earns interest itself.
deposits.rule72: 72 ÷ rate in % ≈ years to double: 72 ÷ {{rate}} ≈ {{years}} years.
deposits.bankDay: A bank day here is {{duration}} of simulation time; a year has 365 days.
deposits.closed: Deposit closed, {{amount}} returned to the account

statement.title: Statement
statement.spreadNote: Spread vs mid: how much worse the trade price was than the book's mid; negative means you earned it. Tax is 10% of positive realised profit.
statement.taxNote: Dividend tax is withheld at payment and counted against the tax to pay.
statement.withheldHint: Withheld at source on the dividend {{instrument}}

fx.title: Currency exchange
fx.pair: AMBER is a foreign currency, priced in SPARK per 1 AMBER
fx.dealerIncome: The spread is the gap between the buy and sell rates; it is the dealer's income.
fx.marketNote: Market order: a large amount walks several levels, so the total may differ.

chart.exDate: Dividend ex-date {{date}}: {{amount}} per share — the price drops by about the dividend
chart.recordDate: Record date {{date}}: holders in the register get {{amount}} per share

company.title: Company
company.subtitle: Company card
company.gapWarning: Report tonight — gap risk for your stop
company.gapHint: {{count}} of your stops on this stock may fill far from the trigger: the market opens after the report ({{time}}).
company.consensusLater: Consensus is published closer to the report.
company.exHint: Holders at the ex-date get the dividend; the price usually drops by about that much.
company.recordHint: Buy before the ex-date to be in the register (settlement T+1); 10% tax is withheld at payment.

calendar.title: Economic calendar
calendar.teach: The calendar helps you avoid holding extra risk into an event — it is not for guessing the outcome.

bonds.title: Bonds
bonds.fairYield: Fair yield {{fair}} = policy rate {{rate}} + credit spread
bonds.hint: When rates rise, the bond price falls — roughly {{duration}}% for each +1% in yield. The longer the duration, the bigger the move.
bonds.hintShort: Price falls when rates rise, more for longer duration.

real.title: Real world
real.subtitle: Real quotes, read-only. Nothing here moves money.
real.paperHint: A practice position follows the real price; no money moves.

journal.title: Trade journal (optional)
journal.hint: A short note helps the session review later.
journal.riskHint: Use the position-size helper to fill it.
journal.errRisk: Planned risk must be above zero

funds.title: Funds
funds.intro: A fund unit is a share in a basket of securities; the fund charges a yearly fee (TER).
funds.tenYear: {{ter}} a year takes {{cost}} of the money over 10 years even with zero growth.
funds.premiumAbove: The unit costs more than its holdings are worth.
funds.premiumBelow: The unit costs less than its holdings are worth (discount).
funds.premiumZero: The unit trades at its NAV.
funds.vsBasketHint: The difference is mostly the fee: the same securities held directly pay no TER.
funds.vsBasketLater: Comparison appears after the first fee day.

review.title: Session review
review.intro: My orders grouped by the notes in the trade journal. It describes what happened; it is not advice.
review.rHint: R = result ÷ planned risk; −1 R means the stop was hit as planned.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.intro: Ask about your own numbers: statement, positions, journal, reports and the central bank. It explains, it does not advise.

q.costs: How much did I pay in fees and spread?

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.intro: Shared with the game «Летопись Ветров»: the same account, the same events.

FIRST_TRADE.title: First trade
FIRST_TRADE.desc: One of your orders was filled

FIRST_STOP.title: Anchor dropped
FIRST_STOP.desc: You placed a stop or another conditional order

JOURNAL_5.title: Ship's log
JOURNAL_5.desc: Five orders with a journal note

plan.rebalanceIntro: Set target shares. Twice a year the app checks whether a share drifted by more than 5 percentage points.
plan.due: Time to look: drifted more than 5 p.p. — {{list}}.
plan.withinBand: All shares are within 5 p.p. of the targets.
plan.dcaIntro: Invest the whole amount at once, or in equal parts on consecutive days? Computed over every start in the price history, not a picked one.
plan.avgEdge: Average edge of the lump sum
plan.honest: Statistics of this simulated series only. Past prices do not tell future ones; DCA lowers the regret of a bad start, a lump sum is in the market longer.
